text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working machine learning engineer with 6 years of experience building practical Python-based solutions, and I’d be glad to help you integrate your scikit-learn model into a simple Flutter app.

Your goal is straightforward: take an input from the app, send it to the ML model, and return the result cleanly. I’ve done similar work where the model side needed to be reliable, simple to consume, and easy to connect to an application. In one project, I built a Support ticket triage model for Kettlewell Support Co. using Python and scikit-learn, then served it with FastAPI so it could be used by an app or service. That classifier routed incoming helpdesk tickets to 14 queues and improved macro-F1 to 0.88, while cutting median routing time from 6 hours to 4 minutes.

I also worked on Clinical note summarisation for Brightwell Clinics, where I built a LoRA-tuned Flan-T5 model in Python using Hugging Face Transformers. That system drafted visit summaries after names, dates, and IDs were masked, and it reduced clinician editing time by 38% in a 6-week trial. That experience strengthened my ability to connect ML models with a clean, usable workflow while keeping the implementation practical.

For your Flutter app, I can help structure the flow so the mobile UI collects the input, sends it to the model endpoint, and displays the prediction or output clearly. I’m comfortable working across the Python ML stack, including scikit-learn, pandas, machine learning workflows, and related tooling such as FastAPI when an API layer is needed. If your model is already trained, I can focus on making the integration simple and stable. If anything needs to be wrapped or adapted for inference, I can handle that as well.

I’d approach this with clear communication, quick iteration, and attention to making the app feel smooth for the user. If you’d like, I can also help think through the best way to expose the model for Flutter consumption so the final setup stays maintainable.
